# Traveler's VPN

> Traveler's VPN (travelersvpn.com) is a smart split-tunnel travel VPN for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Unlike single-switch VPNs, it routes per destination: local apps in the country you're visiting (WeChat, Alipay, Didi, local maps) stay direct and fast, while blocked or home apps (Instagram, WhatsApp, YouTube, X, Gmail) route through the tunnel, automatically and simultaneously. Managed plans provision a private server per user (an IP address nobody else shares); a bring-your-own-server mode connects any Outline, Shadowsocks, WireGuard, or Trojan server.

Pricing (August 2026): free download with a 3-day free trial and no account required. $9.99 one-time 7-day Travel Pass (non-renewing, private managed server, 1 TB data). $14.99/month managed subscription (cancel anytime, 1 TB/month). $2.99 one-time bring-your-own-server unlock. One Universal Purchase covers iPhone, iPad, and a native Mac menu-bar app, with Family Sharing. Publisher: Supra Applications Inc. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/travelers-vpn/id6764288591

- [Does Apple Pay work in China?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/does-apple-pay-work-in-china.html): technically yes on UnionPay rails, practically no with foreign cards at tills; China is QR-payment country; set up Alipay/WeChat Pay with home card instead
- [Do US banking apps work in China?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/do-us-banking-apps-work-in-china.html): mostly yes, banks aren't blocked; real traps are SMS 2FA without roaming and fraud systems flagging Chinese IPs; a consistent private home-country IP avoids flags
- [Does PayPal work in China?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/does-paypal-work-in-china.html): mostly yes, PayPal is licensed in China and reachable; Venmo is US-only by design and fails everywhere abroad; switch PayPal 2FA to authenticator before flying
- [Do Airbnb and Booking.com work in China?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/does-airbnb-work-in-china.html): apps load but Airbnb has no mainland listings since July 2022; many Chinese hotels can't host foreigners; Trip.com is the practical booking tool and flags foreigner-friendly hotels

- [Does Microsoft Teams work in China?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/does-microsoft-teams-work-in-china.html): mostly yes via Microsoft's local partner; failures usually come from corporate tenant geo-fencing, not the firewall; Teams and Zoom work, Slack and Google Meet don't
- [Does Notion work in China?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/does-notion-work-in-china.html): unreliable: not formally blocked but throttled, and offline mode only caches recent pages; export critical pages before flying; Apple Notes and OneNote sync in China
- [Does Threads work in China?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/does-threads-work-in-china.html): no, blocked since its 2023 launch under Meta's standing ban; shares Instagram login so one VPN fixes both
- [Does Roblox work in China?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/does-roblox-work-in-china.html): no, global Roblox unreachable and the licensed Chinese version (LuoBuLeSi) shut in 2021; online-only so no offline fallback; playable over a private low-latency VPN
- [Do Hulu, Max, and Peacock work in China?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/does-hulu-work-in-china.html): no: Hulu and Peacock are US-only everywhere and Max skips China, so their own geo-blocks fire before the firewall matters; downloads play offline; needs a trusted private US IP
- [Does Coinbase work in China?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/does-coinbase-work-in-china.html): no, double-blocked: China banned exchanges in 2021 and blocks their sites, Coinbase doesn't serve the mainland; trading from inside is against Chinese rules; Hong Kong has a licensed regime

- [Are VPNs legal in Dubai and the UAE?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/are-vpns-legal-in-dubai.html): legal to use, illegal to misuse; heavy fines on paper for VPN-assisted crimes; no publicized tourist cases; licensed apps are the zero-judgment option
- [Does Pornhub work in China?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/does-pornhub-work-in-china.html): no, pornography is banned outright in mainland China; criminal penalties target production/distribution/profit, not private viewing; legal and unblocked in Hong Kong and Macau
- [Does OnlyFans work in China?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/does-onlyfans-work-in-china.html): no, blocked under the blanket ban; traveling creators should queue content, fix authenticator 2FA, and keep logins on one consistent home-country IP
- [Does Pornhub work in Dubai?](https://travelersvpn.com/guides/does-pornhub-work-in-dubai.html): no, and accessing pornography in the UAE is an offense in its own right; this site's advice is don't, wait for the flight home

## Key facts

- No account, email, or signup; purchases go through the Apple App Store.
- Built on the open-source sing-box engine with standard protocols; routing uses region-aware rule sets that self-update.
- In BYO mode the operator runs no backend; user traffic never touches Traveler's VPN servers.
- Managed servers are private per user, so there is no shared IP for banks, streaming services, or censors to blocklist.
- Honest limits: it cannot fix Google Maps' offset map data inside China (use Apple Maps there); install before entering China, since app stores and VPN sites are unreachable from inside.
